name: media-plugin
description: Media generation plugin for images, video, music, speech, SVG, sourcing, and data visualization (charts, graphs, diagrams, maps) via D3.js, Mermaid, and Draw.io — fronted by a visual-planning gate.

interface.shortDescription: Generate or source media assets for projects.
interface.longDescription: Provides Codex workflows for visual planning, image generation, stock sourcing, icon lookup, SVG craft, chart/diagram generation (D3.js, Mermaid, Draw.io with vendor-icon shape search), music generation, video generation, and speech creation. A visual-planning gate clarifies, styles, and routes every asset before it is produced.
defaultPrompt: Create image prompts for this landing page.
Generate a chart or diagram for this documentation.
Create a narration plan for this demo video.
